## The heuristic

**Read willingness to pay from what the segment already spends on the job — including the internal headcount doing it manually — not from what buyers say a fair price would be.
**


_Why:_ Stated fair price is anchored on what people wish things cost and is uniformly low. Money already leaving the building every month is revealed preference, and the salary of the person doing it by hand is usually the largest and least-quoted number on the map.
